confidence.description: The resolver's candidate-match score at link creation

created_at.description: When the link was first established; carried verbatim across every refresh

link_id.description: Stable identity of the link across `pursuing → won → delivering → complete`

link_state.description: Customer-declared lifecycle state of the seam

ocid.description: The public OCDS contracting-process identifier this project is linked to

platform_project_id.description: The platform-side project this OCID belongs to, when the hub has resolved one

project_entity_id.description: The tenant project the link anchors to (the fact subject)

source_system.description: Producing system of the fact (`DEMITON` for this shelf)

updated_at.description: When the link last changed state

verified.description: Whether the link was human-confirmed rather than auto-asserted on a fuzzy match

verified_by_user_id.description: The identity that confirmed the link

won_at.description: When the win was declared (present only from `won` onward)
